baseline_evidence: Prior synthetic probe against baseline accepted mode 0644, a symlink and oversized content with trailing invalid bytes.
closure: Current loader opens a descriptor with O_NOFOLLOW/O_CLOEXEC/O_NONBLOCK when supported; fstat regular file; on POSIX requires private permissions and effective-user ownership; reads at most 513 bytes; accepts only strict UTF-8 JSON list of exactly 64 integer bytes and validates with solders; rejects empty, malformed, truncated, oversized and trailing content; sanitized failure has no chained input exception.
result: All targeted cases reject or accept according to policy; 155 focused tests passed overall including keypair coverage.
secret_material: Only synthetic fixture; no real key included.
limitations: POSIX mode/owner semantics tested under Linux only.
Native Windows ACL behavior not tested.
Concurrent hostile filesystem write after descriptor open is outside tested guarantees; descriptor pins inode and bounded read mitigates path substitution.
